name: Lorr
source: Normally a merchant that works in the capital of Gradoa, Lorr has switched up his usual work in order to aid the army by providing supplies. He is generally anti-war, but since Aydin works for the military, Lorr figures he should do his part too. Lorr is amiable even if he's a bit crass, but he isn't the type to let people walk all over him. He knows several languages and can hold his own in a drinking contest-- and he likes to brag about it.
